name: Philadelphia, Pennsylvania

coverage.summary: Retail, hospitality (hotels and motels) and food service employers with 250 or more employees and 30 or more locations worldwide, counting chains and franchise networks together.
coverage.employees: Employees who work in Philadelphia, are eligible for overtime under state or federal law, and do retail, food service or hospitality work. Part-time, seasonal and temporary workers are included.

citation.quote: The Work Schedule shall be posted no later than 14 days before the first day of any new schedule beginning January 1, 2021.

premiums.label: Time added, or shift moved without losing hours, after the posting deadline

citation.quote: One hour of Predictability Pay at the employee's regular rate of pay, when the Covered Employer adds time to a work shift or changes the date or time or location of a work shift, with no loss of hours.

premiums.label: Hours cut or shift cancelled after the posting deadline

citation.quote: Predictability Pay calculated as no less than one-half times the employee's regular rate of pay per hour, for any scheduled hours the employee does not work because the Covered Employer subtracts hours from a regular or on-call shift or cancels a shift.

A Covered Employer shall compensate the employee for each instance that the employee works a shift described in subsection 9-4604(1) [less than 9 hours after the end of the previous day's shift], in the amount of $40 for each such shift.

exceptions.label: I asked for this change in writing
exceptions.description: The employee requested the change in writing, including adding or dropping hours and using sick, vacation or other leave.

exceptions.label: Shift trade or coverage I agreed to with a coworker
exceptions.description: A mutually agreed shift trade or coverage arrangement between employees.

exceptions.label: Work couldn't begin or continue
exceptions.description: Threats to employees or property, a public utility failure or public transit shutdown, fire, flood or other natural disaster, a declared state of emergency, or severe weather that disrupts transportation or threatens safety.

exceptions.label: I volunteered for hours offered to a group
exceptions.description: The employee volunteered, in response to a written mass communication stating that it was voluntary, for hours left open because another employee could not work.

exceptions.label: Hours lost because my job ended
exceptions.description: Hours subtracted because employment was terminated.

exceptions.label: Documented multi-day disciplinary suspension
exceptions.description: Hours subtracted for discipline through a suspension of more than one day, with the incident documented in writing.

exceptions.label: Ticketed event changed for reasons outside the employer's control
exceptions.description: A ticketed event was cancelled, scheduled, rescheduled, postponed, delayed, ran longer, or had at least 20% more attendance than expected, for reasons outside the employer's control after the schedule was posted.

exceptions.label: Hotel banquet booked after the schedule was posted
exceptions.description: A hotel banquet event was scheduled for reasons outside the employer's control after the schedule was posted.

otherRights.label: Right to decline hours not on your posted schedule (consent must be in writing)
Right to decline shifts that start less than 9 hours after your last one

enforcement.agency: Philadelphia Office of Worker Protections (Department of Labor)

sources.title: Bill 180649-A, certified copy (Fair Workweek Employment Standards)

notes: Predictability pay is owed for changes made after the 14-day posting deadline, measured to the first day of the schedule. Changes made within 24 hours after that deadline are exempt (§ 9-4603(2)(g)), so Shiftowed charges for changes made less than 13 days before the schedule starts.
Starting or ending no more than 20 minutes early or late is exempt (§ 9-4603(2)(d)); Shiftowed applies this as a 21-minute threshold.
The $40 rest premium is owed even when you agreed to work the shift.
Tipped employees' regular rate is set each year by regulation (reported as $17.88/hour for July 2026 to June 2027). Check the city's current figure and enter it as your rate.
